entries.topic: ICE data and surveillance contracts beyond Palantir

claims.text: LexisNexis Risk Solutions contract 70CMSD21C00000001 (Feb 2021, ~$24.51m obligations/ceiling) ends 31 Aug 2026; ICE notice of intent 10 Aug 2026 for sole-source bridge est. $6.7m (seven-month base plus five one-month options); requirements call for APIs to ICE applications 'such as but not limited to' the Palantir platform, PenLink and ICE Data Analytics; 1.2m+ Accurint person searches Mar-Sep 2021 (Just Futures Law records)

Thomson Reuters CLEAR: DHS contract renewed sole-source as of 31 Mar 2026; data include licences, vehicle registrations, credit data, real estate, court records, utility data; TR says CLEAR excludes immigration status, call logs, bank data; LEIDS-5 $22.8m (May 2021-May 2026) LPR data, does not include CLEAR; Jail Alert Service $6.7m 2018-23; TR says Palantir is not a CLEAR customer; LexisNexis LEIDS $22.1m 2021-26

Zignal Labs: ICE/HSI $5.7m five-year licences via Carahsoft, public Sept 2025, 'real-time data analysis for criminal investigations'; Zignal says it analyses 8bn+ posts a day; 2025 pamphlet claims 'tactical intelligence' to operators in Gaza; Zignal did not respond
ShadowDragon SocialNet: ICE delivery orders via resellers $289,500 (start 16 July 2020) and $602,056 (start 31 Aug 2021)

Babel Street: ICE $1.1m delivery order via Thundercat (start 19 Sept 2018) and $1.5m BPA call to Babel Street (start 12 Sept 2019); Babel Street sells Locate X location software; contract descriptions say 'Babel Street software'

70 lawmakers (3 Mar 2026) asked DHS IG to investigate warrantless location-data purchases; DHS signed $2.3m contract with PenLink in Sept 2025 for Webloc; Webloc developed by Cobwebs, combined with PenLink in 2023 PE deal; ICE spokesperson: 'ICE does not purchase illegal information'

ICE $2.3m Penlink contract fall 2025 covers Tangles (OSINT) and Webloc (phone location database); Penlink bought Cobwebs in 2023; Penlink: tools 'exclusively use publicly or commercially available data'

OIG-23-61: CBP, ICE, USSS did not adhere to privacy policies or complete required Privacy Impact Assessments before procuring and using commercial telemetry data; recommended ICE discontinue CTD use until PIAs approved
DHS forecast (May 2026): five-year ICE/HSI IDIQ, $100m ceiling, Cellebrite phone and drone forensics; 'the most widely utilized and deployed computer forensic tool' in HSI
ICE/HSI Clearview AI deal finalised 5 Sept 2025: $3.75m obligated, ~$9.2m total with options; child sexual exploitation and assaults on officers

entries.topic: Purchased data, ODNI CAI report, data-broker bill, DHS subpoenas, AAUP v. Rubio, vetting rules

claims.text: ODNI senior advisory group report (Jan 2022), declassified 12 June 2023: IC collects 'significant amount of CAI'; CAI 'can reveal sensitive and intimate information'; recommends cataloguing, standards and more precise sensitivity guidance
ODNI report: CAI could be used to 'cause harm to an individual's reputation, emotional well-being, or physical safety'; once required targeted investigation
House passed Fourth Amendment Is Not For Sale Act 219-199 (April 2024) to close the 'data broker loophole'; sent to Senate

Davidson (14 Apr 2026) introduced FISA-reauthorization amendment to 'prohibit the federal government from purchasing Americans' private information and data from third-party brokers'; no vote reported

HSI administrative subpoena to Google (31 Mar 2025) for Amandla Thomas-Johnson's account under 8 USC 1225; Google complied without prior notice, produced basic subscriber information; Momodou Taal subpoenas to Meta and Google withdrawn after he left and dismissed suit

Early Sept 2025 DHS subpoena to Meta sought 'names, email addresses, and phone numbers' for six Instagram accounts that named a Border Patrol agent; Magistrate Judge Alex Tse ordered Meta not to produce (24 Sept 2025)

EFF/ACLU NorCal letter 10 Feb 2026 to ten companies: require court order, notify users, resist gag orders; DHS withdrew Instagram subpoenas before ruling; administrative subpoenas not approved by a judge; Google 28,622 and Meta 14,520 subpoenas of all types H1 2025, DHS share unknown

Philadelphia-area 'Jon Doe' emailed a DHS attorney urging 'common sense and decency'; administrative subpoena to Google issued four hours later; two DHS agents and local officer visited his home; Google had not fulfilled it; motion to quash 2 Feb 2026; ACLU release titled DHS withdraws subpoena, 10 Feb 2026

AAUP v. Rubio (D. Mass., Young J.): filed 25 Mar 2025; bench trial 7-21 July 2025; 30 Sept 2025 policy unconstitutional, 'chilled the speech of non-citizen academics'; Jan 2026 judgment vacated policy, presumption of retaliation and automatic stay of removal for members; appeal No. 26-01141 to First Circuit filed 9 Feb 2026, cross-appeal; stay denied 11 Mar 2026 except monetary sanctions; appeal pending as of Oct 2026
Hatch (DHS Office of Intelligence/HSI) testified reports drew on a 5,000-name Canary Mission list, 'Tiger Team'; more than 100 reports; never before asked to produce reports on foreign students

State Dept cable 18 June 2025: F, M, J applicants to set social media 'public'; vet for 'hostile attitudes toward our citizens, culture, government, institutions, or founding principles'; private accounts may signal evasiveness

USCIS 9 Apr 2025: screen social media for antisemitic activity, support for Hamas, PIJ, Hezbollah, Houthis as grounds to deny benefits; applies to green-card applicants and students; CAIR and J Street criticised

Montana SB 282 (Sen. Emrich), signed by Gov. Gianforte May 2025: government entities generally may not buy electronic communications, precise geolocation or other sensitive data without a warrant or investigative subpoena; first state to restrict the practice

entries.topic: Ecosystem map: layers, records, oversight letters

claims.text: Brennan (29 Jul 2026): DHS >$2.9bn on surveillance/data tools since Jan 2021; biometrics >$1bn; General Atomics drones >$675m; Palantir commitments $20.4m (2024) to $162.2m (2026 to date); RAVEn (Booz Allen, Acuity, Alethix) combines multiple databases into profiles; DHS accessed local LPR incl. Flock via other agencies; vehicle/driver data via sharing contracts ~$2m since 2021

Brennan (9 Jul 2026): ICM 'structures and links data collected from these vendors and other commercial entities'; being made HSI's 'authoritative data source'; ImmigrationOS 'assembles ICE's data streams into a central hub'

Guardian (22 Sep 2025, Just Futures Law FOIA records 2014-2022): ICM/FALCON gave access to 'a network of federally and privately owned databases'; March 2020 training on searching SEVIS; 2020 emails planned APIS and CBP border-crossing searches; NCIC among sources; Cellebrite extractions could be imported; CLEAR 'is not connected to Palantir tools'

HART PIA 14 Aug 2024: not yet operational; fingerprint, latent, iris, face (no DNA); users all DHS, DOS, DOJ, DOD, OPM, IC, state/local police, foreign partners; interoperable with DOJ NGI and DOD ABIS

Warner-Kaine letter 29 Jan 2026 to DHS IG on ICE/CBP biometric and surveillance tools; DHS OIG opened audit 'DHS' Security of Biometric Data and Personally Identifiable Information' (Feb 2026); no report located by 28 Oct 2026

Letter of 14 Apr 2026 (33 signers, Goldman, Velázquez, Wyden first) to Sec. Mullin and Acting Director Lyons asked for all DHS-Palantir contracts since 2020, datasets in Palantir systems, US-citizen data, facial recognition errors, observers and protesters; names ELITE, Clearview, PenLink, Stingray, Paragon; deadline 24 Apr 2026; no DHS reply found
DHS to NPR 22 May 2026: 'ICE has no relationship with Paragon Solutions, Inc. or with the company that acquired them'; would not confirm or deny continued capability; contract closed out 20 Jan 2026

The 74 (10 Feb 2026): Flock logs at Alvin ISD's 8 cameras, one month Dec 2025-Jan 2026: >3,100 agencies ran >733,000 searches; 620 cited immigration reasons from 30 agencies; districts showed no immigration use themselves; Flock says customers control sharing
The Work Number (Equifax Workforce Solutions) holds 'data collected from employers and payroll processors' and supplies agencies for public-assistance eligibility and child-support enforcement
New York v. ACF (D.D.C. 1:26-cv-02726, Boasberg): PI denied 28 Sep 2026 against HHS sharing TANF recipient data with DHS; 'vague, unsubstantiated predictions'; notice effective 30 Sep 2026
LexisNexis bridge PWS (22 Jul 2026) requires APIs to the Palantir platform, PenLink and ICE Data Analytics; 2020 LEIDS solicitation required interface with 'FALCON/Raven Palantir systems'
